description:
Search active gTLD domains from a database of ~240 million registered domains, filtered by keyword, TLD, length, and character set. A market-analysis instrument for keyword distribution and saturation; results are registered domains, not available for registration.

Related: expired, whois, dns.

keyword.description: Brand or industry term (min 2 chars). Omit to use TLD browse mode, which requires a registered account.

position.description: Keyword placement in domain name. Default is 'all' (substring match). Unlike the other search tools, this one has no minimum-length restriction on substring matching.

status.description: Filter by status: 'forsale' for domains listed for sale

tld.description: Filter by TLD (e.g., 'com', 'net', 'org'); when keyword is omitted, this is the browse target (TLD browse mode requires a registered account)

tld_count_max.description: Maximum cross-TLD registration count for the name. Integer 0-10000. See tld_count_min.

tld_count_min.description: Minimum cross-TLD registration count for the name. Integer 0-10000. Combine with tld_count_max for a range; set both equal for an exact count.

name: active

marketplace.description: Sale platform code where the domain is listed: se=Sedo, go=GoDaddy, at=Atom, vn=Venture, pd=PerfectDomain, gn=Gname. Present only when the domain is listed for sale.

price.description: Listing price with currency, e.g. 1500 USD. Only present for Atom/Sedo listings

error.description: Error message when success is false

total.description: Number of results on this page

total_found.description: Total matching results across all pages; the primary metric for comparative analysis

title: Active Domain Search
